title: 宝塚記念の後に・背中は答えない

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The battle at the Takarazuka Kinen ends with Biwa Hayahide taking first place.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the race, Ticket tells Hayahide how she hopes they can stay rivals forever and always run the best of races together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But Biwa Hayahide replies that unlike when they clashed at the Japanese Derby, she finds it difficult to consider Winning Ticket her rival anymore.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hayahide tells her to think long and hard about the reason why she races, leaving Ticket dumbfounded.
